changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0069. Store a private profile picture reference on the user account. Index review: no new index; the picture is loaded with the user row by PK_Users. Performance note: the columns ride the existing user lookup used by sign-in and directory pages.

rollback.sql: IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.Users', N'PhotoContentType') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.Users DROP COLUMN PhotoContentType;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'app.Users', N'PhotoStorageKey') IS NOT NULL ALTER TABLE app.Users DROP COLUMN PhotoStorageKey;
